findings.evidence: Signs.lean:80-108 and Infinity.lean:24-63 carry `[Field R]`; `Polynomial.eval`/`leadingCoeff` need only a semiring. Mathlib states the coefficient analogue at `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/RuleOfSigns.lean:46 `variable {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] (P : Polynomial R)`; `def signVariations : ℕ := P.coeffList.signVariations``, and `mathlib/Mathlib/Data/List/SignVariations.lean:43 `variable {α : Type*} [Zero α] [LinearOrder α]``. This PR's own `List.firstSign` (TauCeti/Data/List/SignVariations.lean:20) is already at `[Zero R] [LinearOrder R]`.
findings.fix: Put `signVariationsAt`/`signVariationsAtTop` and their `_def`/`_nil`/`_singleton`/`_cons` lemmas in a `variable {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R]` section, `signVariationsAtBot` in a `[Ring R] [LinearOrder R]` one (only `(-1) ^ natDegree` needs negation), and keep `Field`/`IsStrictOrderedRing` on the later results that need them (`signVariationsAt_map_mul`, `signVariationsAt_const`).
findings.issue: `signVariationsAt` and its basic lemmas (`signVariationsAt_def` :88, `_nil` :93, `_singleton` :97, `_cons` :103) are stated under `[Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]`, but use neither inverses nor the ordered-ring structure; the author already `omit`s `IsStrictOrderedRing` and left `Field` in place. Same for `signVariationsAtTop` (Infinity.lean:27, plus `_def` :36, `_nil` :47, `_singleton` :52) and `signVariationsAtBot` (Infinity.lean:31, plus `_def` :41, `_nil` :57, `_singleton` :62). A downstream sign-variation development over a non-field ordered ring (e.g. `ℤ[X]`) cannot reuse these and would have to duplicate the definitions.

findings.evidence: `sum_sign` signature Tarski.lean:132-135 `(h : Signed (p :: q :: cs))`; `Signed [p]` is constructed at SignedRemainders.lean:229-240 (`sturmSeq_zero_right` branch). The four degenerate blocks are textually identical modulo the interval filter: Tarski.lean:232-239 vs Infinity.lean:177-183, 199-205, 220-224. Singleton validity: with `IsTarskiSeed p f 0`, `sign_eq`/`eval_eq_zero` (Tarski.lean:71-92) give `f.eval r = 0` at each simple root, so the sum is 0, matching `signVariationsAt_singleton` = 0 and `signVariationsAtTop_singleton` = 0.
findings.fix: Either restate `sum_sign` for `Signed (p :: cs)` with `hseed : IsTarskiSeed p f (cs.head?.getD 0)` — true for `cs = []`, since `IsTarskiSeed p f 0` plus `hsimple` forces `f.eval r = 0` at every root of `p`, and `signVariationsAt [p] x = 0` at both ends — and derive the length-≥2 case; or add one shared lemma establishing chain shape and seed for `sturmSeq p (f * p.derivative)` once (`IsTarskiSeed p f ((sturmSeq p (f * p.derivative)).tail.head?.getD 0)`), and reduce the four theorems to its instances.
findings.issue: `sum_sign` is stated only for chains `p :: q :: cs`, although `Signed` admits the singleton `[p]` that `sturmSeq p (f * p.derivative)` actually produces when `f * p.derivative = 0`. The excluded case is proved separately (`IsTarskiSeed.sum_sign_eq_zero`, Tarski.lean:212) and the same `by_cases hq : f * p.derivative = 0` / `sturmSeq_zero_right` / `sum_sign_eq_zero` glue is then repeated verbatim in all four concrete theorems: Tarski.lean:230-242, Infinity.lean:174-186 (`sum_sign_sturmSeq_Ioi`), 196-208 (`sum_sign_sturmSeq_Iio`), 217-227 (`sum_sign_sturmSeq_univ`). Every external caller instantiating with a reduced seed (`IsTarskiSeed.mod`) must reproduce the split too.

summary: The earlier redundant-nonvanishing premises are gone. Remaining: the three sign-variation definitions are pinned to `Field` though the notion is semiring-level, and `sum_sign` excludes singleton chains, forcing the same eight-line degenerate case-split into four concrete theorems.
